title: Tibetan Ice May Preserve the Last Ice Age
paragraphs: Scientists studied old ice in Tibet. The ice is on a high plateau in the northwest. It is called the Guliya ice cap.
The team took ice cores from the ice in 1992 and in 2015. A core is a long tube of ice. The two cores looked very similar inside.
The scientists think some ice may be more than 128,000 years old. It may keep a record of the last ice age. They want to test more samples.

questions.a: On a high plateau in northwest Tibet.
